content:
Ads will launch in Apple Maps in the United States and Canada later this summer. Ahead of the feature's rollout, Apple has shared more details about what Apple Maps ads will and won't allow.

Apple Maps ads are on the way, and Apple is simultaneously revealing the categories that will be banned.

Apple first announced plans to bring ads to Apple Maps back in March. The company said ads would appear at the top of search results, as well as in a new "Suggested Places" widget within the app.

Apple laid the groundwork for this back in May with iOS 26.5, which included the new "Suggested Places" feature. However, the company hasn't shared an update on when Apple Maps ads will actually launch since then.

As spotted by TechCrunch, Apple has now updated its Apple Advertising Services guidelines with new information related to Apple Maps.

The guidelines cover ads across services like Apple News, Stocks, and Maps, and include a list of prohibited content that applies to ads across all services, such as violence, weapons, drugs, and more.

Perhaps the most noteworthy detail is the further specifics regarding Apple Maps ads. Apple says there are three additional categories of content that are banned for Apple Maps ads specifically:

  • Home Services: Ad content that contains or directly or indirectly promotes home services, including but not limited to services such as plumbing, locksmiths, HVAC, pest control, roofing, or general contracting.
  • Bail Bonds: Ad content that contains or directly or indirectly promotes bail bonds or surety bonds services related to pre-trial release in criminal cases.
  • Crypto ATMs: Ad content that contains or directly or indirectly promotes cryptocurrency ATMs.

Additionally, Apple says ads related to medical services will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

As TechCrunch points out, it's interesting that Apple is banning ads from the entire "home services" category. It's one of the main ad categories for Google Maps, but Apple clearly has no interest in bringing these kinds of ads to Apple Maps.

All signs point to Apple launching ads in Apple Maps soon. However, the company still hasn't announced an official launch date just yet.

For a full list of all banned ad categories across Apple's services, you can visit the company's website.
